content_sections.heading: About PM Shri KV AFS Chandinagar
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Chandinagar is a school at Air Force Station, Chandinagar. It is engaging the Special Educator for its 2026-27 academic session.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the school. Original certificates and self-attested copies are required for verification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis. It applies to the session 2026-27. The post is at PM Shri KV AFS Chandinagar.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PM Shri KV AFS Chandinagar Special Educator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the Special Educator application form and fill it in completely. Go to the School Premises, PM Shri KV AFS Chandinagar on 3 November 2026. Register from 9:00 AM onwards. Attend the interview with your documents. Documents to carry: Fully completed application form Original certificates One set of self-attested copies for verification

faq.question: Q1. Is the Special Educator post at PM Shri KV AFS Chandinagar permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes the engagement as purely contractual, for the session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What time should I reach the school for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Registration on 3 November 2026 runs from 9:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need to take photocopies of my certificates?
faq.answer: Yes. Carry one set of self-attested copies along with your original certificates.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview being held?
faq.answer: The interview takes place on the school premises of PM Shri KV AFS Chandinagar.
